Data.Text: The Greensborough Bypass is closed southbound at the ramp to the M80 Metropolitan Ring Road. The Eastern Freeway's got a patchy run citybound at Burke Road, with about four kays affected. There's construction on the Calder Freeway citybound between Keilor Park Drive and the Tullamarine Freeway, across about twenty-five kays. The Tulla's a bit slow citybound between Melbourne Airport and Mickleham Road, and the West Gate's under the pump through construction. Minor delays too on the Western Freeway at Hopkins Road. Mulgrave's slow at Springvale Road, with breakdowns on Doncaster Road and at Blackburn Road in Glen Waverley.
